# AgentSec Triage

AgentSec Triage performs deterministic, read-only, offline-by-default triage of
explicit local repository roots using source, dependency, or repository scope
for evidence associated with documented developer,
software-supply-chain, and coding-agent attacks. It reports findings,
diagnostics, and incomplete coverage; it does not certify a system as clean.

- [Project overview](https://github.com/FlorianBruniaux/agentsec-triage/blob/main/README.md)
